description: Simulate an emergency security response by locking down the JFrog Artifactory instance. You must: 1) Enable 'Offline Mode' to disconnect from remote repositories. 2) Disable 'Anonymous Access' to prevent unauthenticated access. 3) Set the System Message to exactly: 'SECURITY ALERT: System in Offline Lockdown'. Log in as 'admin' with password 'password'. These settings are located in the Administration module under General Settings (for Offline Mode and Message) and Security Configuration (for Anonymous Access).

metadata.target_message: SECURITY ALERT: System in Offline Lockdown
